build_subzero_runtime: build the Subzero runtime support library for all architectures using pnacl toolchain
run_build_runtime_verbose: run build-runtime.py with verbose flag to display debugging output during runtime compilation
build_runtime_for_target: build native, sandboxed, and nonsfi runtimes for a specific target architecture
translate_bitcode_to_object: translate a set of input bitcode files into a single object file using pnacl-llc
exclude_target_runtime: exclude specific target architectures from runtime build using --exclude-target flag
